title: Feature Request: Microsoft 365 Connector for Max Plan Individual Users
body:
## Summary

The Microsoft 365 connector is currently restricted to Team and Enterprise plans only. Individual users on the Max plan ($100/month or $200/month) cannot access this integration, despite paying more per-user than Team plan subscribers ($30/seat).

## The Problem

| Plan | Price | M365 Connector Access |
|------|-------|----------------------|
| Max 5x | $100/month | ❌ No |
| Max 20x | $200/month | ❌ No |
| Team | $30/seat/month | ✅ Yes |
| Enterprise | Custom | ✅ Yes |

A Max 20x subscriber paying $200/month has fewer integration capabilities than a single-seat Team user paying $30/month. This pricing/feature disparity doesn't align with reasonable customer expectations.

## Use Case

Individual power users (consultants, solo developers, freelancers) who:
- Work with clients using Microsoft 365
- Store documents in OneDrive
- Need Claude to access and analyze their own files
- Don't need team collaboration features
- Are willing to pay premium individual pricing

## Requested Change

Enable the Microsoft 365 connector for Max plan subscribers. The connector is read-only and operates within the user's existing M365 permissions, so there's no additional security concern beyond what Team users already have.

## Technical Note

The connector already exists and works. This is purely a business/licensing gate, not a technical limitation. Individual Max users can already use custom MCP connectors - the official M365 connector is artificially restricted.

## Comparison

Other pre-built connectors (Asana, Linear, Sentry, Zapier, Cloudflare, etc.) are available to all paid plans including Pro and Max. Only Slack and Microsoft 365 are carved out for Team/Enterprise exclusively. Given that M365 is the dominant productivity suite, this exclusion significantly limits Max plan value for professional individual users.

---

*Submitted on behalf of a Max plan subscriber who discovered this limitation while attempting to integrate OneDrive file access with Claude Code.*

top_comments.body: Confirming that directory connectors should work across plans. Thank you for the report!

top_comments.author: RRyanChadwick
top_comments.body: I am a solo lawyer and tech developer with two Max plans. I just downgraded one to Pro and am deciding what to do with the other. ChatGPT offers this connector to all paid plans and much more cost effectively for business plans by only requiring two seats in a plan. It does not make sense to buy empty Teams seats instead of spending money on usage. You should support you small business customers by either turning on this connector for Max plans or reducing the number of seats required for a Team
